column4: cleat#2218: this test loops over registeredBackends (postgres, mysql, mssql) proving DeliverSignal's EXISTS-gated write closes the FK-error-vs-nil existence oracle on every dialect. This job sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) but no CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL or CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the mysql and mssql subtests skip here on every run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestDeliverSignalToAnIDTheCallerCannotTouchWritesNothing -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly two.
same dialect gating as the test-go/engine line above, and the cluster job sweeps ./engine/... too.
